description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Visual preferences icons:** every RVX setting has an icon now. The settings that had none or a blank space, such as `Card corner radius` and `Dynamic card colors`, show a matching icon in `Regular` and `Bold`.

### YouTube Music
- **Visual preferences icons:** the RVX sub-settings (Lyrics, Scrobbling, Player, SponsorBlock, Ads, Return YouTube Dislike, Account, Crossfade and the others) have icons now.

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Visual preferences icons:** new icon style `Bold (stock size)`. It draws the bold icons at the size of YouTube's own settings icons (24 dp) instead of 48 dp.
- **Visual preferences icons:** the patch prints a warning when an RVX setting has no icon, so a new setting is not forgotten.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.19.1...v1.20.0)
